# External-data search — 13 November2026

Scope remains anonymous downloads only; domestic first divisions of Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A and Ligue1; usable tracking plus possession supervision and a usable licence. No new eligible fresh match has been confirmed in this check.

- **Driblab open-data — new lead:** the [provider README](https://github.com/driblab/open-data/blob/main/README.md) describes ten broadcast-tracked matches from2025 including the top five leagues and Champions League, at10Hz with named player metadata, ball XYZ and movement features. Cups must be excluded. The [current repository root](https://github.com/driblab/open-data) displays images, `.gitattributes` and README, but not the advertised `dataset-1` folder or a licence. Possession labels are not established by the documented schema. The repository also has an [open missing-data-folder issue](https://github.com/driblab/open-data/issues/3). Treat this as a lead, not rights-cleared labelled data. No assets used for training/testing.
- **SkillCorner current open-data:** [official repository](https://github.com/SkillCorner/opendata) currently describes A-League matches, outside the requested league scope. Previously downloaded historical European matches are already used/viewed and cannot be called fresh.
- **IDSSE/Sportec:** the [primary paper](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-025-04505-y) describes two Bundesliga and five second-division matches, CC BY4.0. The [PySport mirror](https://huggingface.co/datasets/pysport/idsse-data/blob/main/README.md) is the same dataset, not additional fresh matches. Existing copies must not be counted twice; second division is excluded from new top-five-only work.
- **Premier League2024/25 and2025/26:** [24/25](https://huggingface.co/datasets/peggy44/PremierLeague24-25) and [25/26](https://huggingface.co/datasets/peggy44/PremierLeague25-26) explicitly require login, information sharing and acceptance before accessing data. Excluded under anonymous-only preference.
- **Real Madrid collection:** [dataset card](https://huggingface.co/datasets/peggy44/RealMadrid24-25) likewise requires login, information sharing and acceptance. It includes multiple competitions, not only La Liga. Excluded; not downloaded.

Event-only feeds and broadcast videos are not substitutes for a continuous, independently labelled possession benchmark. Do not infer licensing from a repository's public visibility or turn proximity-derived labels into independent ground truth. No access gates were bypassed and no provider was contacted.
